summary: Been sick all day only crawled out of bed to chauffeur kids, record a podcast (miracle I held it in until the end, and to stumble into porcelain office. Spent day finally celebrating Matrix anniversary by watching trilogy. Not sure if I will improve it by skipping second movie.

body_html:
Been sick all day only crawled out of bed to chauffeur kids, record a podcast (miracle I held it in until the end, and to stumble into porcelain office.

Spent day finally celebrating Matrix anniversary by watching trilogy. Not sure if I will improve it by skipping second movie.
